hooks.command: bash -c 'if [ ! -x ./gradlew ]; then echo "FoldOpti: no gradlew yet, skipping check" 1>&2; elif [ -n "$ANDROID_HOME" ] || [ -f local.properties ]; then ./gradlew check 1>&2 || exit 2; else echo "FoldOpti: no Android SDK detected (ANDROID_HOME / local.properties), skipping check" 1>&2; fi'
